responsibility: Is the declarative source table for the newer rs6000 builtin-generation pipeline. It groups PowerPC builtins into gated stanzas keyed by ISA or feature predicates, and for each builtin records its source-level prototype, unique internal ID, target RTL pattern name, and special expansion attributes such as vec_init/vec_extract, HTM, MMA, endianness, or cpu-support handling; rs6000-gen-builtins.c parses this file to generate builtin enums, type tables, initialization code, and overload support metadata.
